events.name: Coworking MeetUp #54 – Digital Nomads Porto
events.location: Gallery Hostel Porto, Rua de Miguel Bombarda 222, Porto
events.description: A full day of coworking for Porto's digital nomad community at Gallery Hostel in the Miguel Bombarda art district. Work alongside fellow remote workers, then unwind at the on-site café, restaurant, and cocktail bar. Part of a recurring weekly Wednesday series.

events.name: Community Gathering: Sustainability Edition
events.description: UPTEC and Google Cloud host an open-air networking afternoon for entrepreneurs and innovators, featuring a roundtable on sustainable entrepreneurship with Portuguese business leaders and the Climate LaunchPad Portugal Final, followed by cocktails, food, a DJ set, and booths from InvestPorto, Porto Business School, and the European Innovation Academy.

events.name: Meaningful Meal with Melissa
events.location: LOOK.Sharp Cafe, Rua Cimo de Vila 41, Porto
events.description: A dinner-and-conversation social evening hosted by transformational coach Melissa Veras, using guided card decks to spark authentic conversation among strangers over a three-course meal with a house drink included.

events.name: PM Lean Coffee (Porto)
events.location: QiBit Porto, Rua Engenheiro Ferreira Dias 978, Piso 1, Porto
events.description: PMI Portugal's agenda-less discussion format for project/program/agile practitioners — participants propose topics, vote on a priority list, then discuss in timed slots. Facilitated by Eduardo Espinheira (QAValue).

events.name: Quiz Night at CastleRock Pub & Hotel
events.location: CastleRock Pub & Hotel, R. do Conde de Vizela 114, Porto
events.description: Weekly Thursday pub quiz — 50 questions across two rounds for teams of up to 5 (extra members incur a 2-point penalty). The winning team gets up to €50 of free drinks; phones are banned during play. Recurring every Thursday.

events.name: Furiosa Dance – Salsa, Bachata & Kizomba Social
events.location: Dimare Café, Vila Nova de Gaia
events.description: Weekly Thursday Latin-dance evening — a beginner-friendly Bachata Sensual & Fusion class followed by a social party mixing Bachata, Salsa, and Kizomba. No partner or prior experience needed; couples-friendly.

events.name: The Fonseca Experience — Port Wine Tasting
events.location: Fonseca Port Wine Cellars, Rua do Choupelo 84, Vila Nova de Gaia
events.description: Self-guided cellar experience with a commented tasting of Fonseca Bin № 27, Siroco, and Terra Prima in the historic tasting room. Open daily 11:00–18:00 (last admission); this listing reflects the daily opening slot.

events.name: Epicure Club Sessions
events.location: Espaço Ignez, Rua da Restauração 252, Porto
events.description: A rooftop DJ party at one of Porto's most scenic viewpoints, featuring sets from Miguel Nery, JOMA, and LØT running through the evening into the night.

events.name: Tropical Oporto Dance Congress 2026
events.location: Golden Tulip Porto Gaia Hotel & SPA, R. da Bélgica 86, Vila Nova de Gaia
events.description: An international salsa and bachata weekend congress with daytime partner-dance workshops for all levels plus evening social parties, including a dedicated couples pass — a couples-friendly social dance experience just across the river from Porto.

events.name: Porto Tech Mixer and Social
events.location: Bonaparte Downtown, P. de Guilherme Gomes Fernandes 40, Porto
events.description: A weekly Friday afterwork social for Porto's tech, AI, data, and IT crowd — casual drinks and networking among software developers, data scientists, and cybersecurity professionals.

events.name: Juanes – World Tour 2026
events.location: Super Bock Arena – Pavilhão Rosa Mota, Porto
events.description: Grammy-winning Colombian artist Juanes brings his World Tour 2026 to Porto, showcasing his new album "Juanes Teban" alongside career-defining hits, with Portuguese singer Rita Rocha opening. Doors 20:30.

events.name: Boardgames Night at LOOK.Sharp
events.location: LOOK.Sharp Cafe, Rua Cimo de Vila 41, Porto
events.description: Porto's longest-running board game social — classic and modern games with food and new connections in a relaxed café setting. Runs every Thursday and Sunday, doors 18:00 until 22:30.

events.name: Startup Portugal Hangout – PITCH, please!
events.location: Edifício Transparente (Workin Porto), Via do Castelo do Queijo 335, Porto
events.description: Startup Portugal's monthly Above & Beyond Hangout, this edition dedicated to founder pitch sessions in front of the local entrepreneurial ecosystem — founders, investors, and community members networking afterward.

events.name: Porto Social and Language Exchange
events.location: Bonaparte Downtown, P. de Guilherme Gomes Fernandes 40, Porto
events.description: A weekly Friday mixer welcoming expats, international students, travelers, and locals to meet new people and practice languages over drinks and food.
